description: This file implements command-line interface logic for connecting to a gateway in the OpenClaw project. It defines options parsing, connection handling, and output formatting for the 'connect' command, including network endpoint resolution and health checks.

classes.name: ConnectOptions
classes.description: Struct representing command-line options for the connect command, with a static parse method.

classes.name: ConnectOutput
classes.description: Encodable struct for outputting connection status and details.

classes.name: SnapshotStore
classes.description: Actor for storing and retrieving HelloOk snapshot data.

methods.name: runConnect
methods.description: Main async function to execute the connect command, handling connection logic and output.

methods.name: printConnectOutput
methods.description: Formats and prints the connection output, either as JSON or plain text.

methods.name: resolveGatewayEndpoint
methods.description: Resolves the network endpoint based on options and configuration.

methods.name: bestEffortEndpoint
methods.description: Attempts to resolve an endpoint, returning nil if unsuccessful.

methods.name: gatewayEndpoint
methods.description: Creates a GatewayEndpoint from a raw URL and options.

methods.name: resolvedToken
methods.description: Resolves the token to use based on options and config.

methods.name: resolvedPassword
methods.description: Resolves the password to use based on options and config.

methods.name: resolveLocalHost
methods.description: Determines local host address, with special handling for 'tailnet'.
